title: Practice 1: Нет, не было: having none

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Не было ___ (никакие зацепки), которые указывали бы на личность убийцы.
exercises.prompt: There was no clue as to the identity of the murderer.
exercises.why: «The direct object of a verb with negation (with не) is often in the genitive case instead of the accusative.» «Conversely, to say 'There isn't...', 'There aren't...', we use the word нет followed by the genitive case.» — DLI, Lesson 27; Wikibooks, «Genitive case».
